name: himalayas
description: Himalayas workflows for remote job search and hiring: search jobs and companies, check salaries, tailor applications, track them, and post jobs and source candidates through the hosted Himalayas MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Find remote jobs and hire remote talent from ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Himalayas is a remote jobs marketplace. These skills connect to the hosted Himalayas MCP to search remote jobs and companies, check salary benchmarks, tailor a resume and cover letter to a job, track applications and practise interviews, and, for employers, post jobs, keep a company profile current and message candidates, confirming every change first.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find remote jobs that match my Himalayas profile
